question: Do finite exhaustive E19:all endpoint controls show that W23/W25 relaxations change the exact output-zero set?
number: Exact fixed-prefix endpoint controls over 2^32 E19 values: baseline 557 cells and 557 joint exact outputs; dropping all W23 conditions leaves 557/557; dropping the active W25 relation gives 1050/557; dropping all W23/W25 conditions gives 1545/557; dropping only the signed W25 bit leaves 557/557. Every tested variant has the same 557 joint output-zero cases.
